Record Class BorrowBooksControl

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
library.controls.BorrowBooksControl
public record BorrowBooksControl(Repository repository) extends Record
Represents the control class for borrowing, reading, and returning books. Provides the functionality to borrow books for a specific duration, read borrowed books, check if a book is borrowed, and return borrowed books.
